description: Source code implementing auto-hinting routines for font rendering in the FreeType project, including functions for managing segments, edges, points, and hinting algorithms for font outlines.

methods.name: af_axis_hints_new_segment
methods.description: Creates a new segment for a given axis, managing embedded and dynamic memory.

methods.name: af_axis_hints_new_edge
methods.description: Creates a new edge for a given axis, managing embedded and dynamic memory, and inserts it in order.

methods.name: af_glyph_hints_dump_points
methods.description: Outputs the list of points in a glyph hints structure for debugging.

methods.name: af_edge_flags_to_string
methods.description: Converts edge flags to a human-readable string.

methods.name: af_glyph_hints_dump_segments
methods.description: Outputs the list of segments in a glyph hints structure for debugging.

methods.name: af_glyph_hints_get_num_segments
methods.description: Retrieves the number of segments for a given dimension.

methods.name: af_glyph_hints_get_segment_offset
methods.description: Fetches the offset and related info of a segment by index.

methods.name: af_glyph_hints_dump_edges
methods.description: Outputs the list of edges in a glyph hints structure for debugging.

methods.name: af_direction_compute
methods.description: Computes the direction (up, down, left, right, none) of a vector.

methods.name: af_glyph_hints_init
methods.description: Initializes a glyph hints structure.

methods.name: af_glyph_hints_done
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a glyph hints structure.

methods.name: af_glyph_hints_rescale
methods.description: Rescales hints according to font metrics.

methods.name: af_glyph_hints_reload
methods.description: Reloads and recomputes hints from an outline.

methods.name: af_glyph_hints_save
methods.description: Stores the hinted outline back into an FT_Outline structure.

methods.name: af_glyph_hints_align_edge_points
methods.description: Aligns edge points to their respective edges.

methods.name: af_glyph_hints_align_strong_points
methods.description: Aligns strong points to edges, similar to TrueType IP hinting.

methods.name: af_iup_shift
methods.description: Shifts points between two references to match hinted coordinates.

methods.name: af_iup_interp
methods.description: Interpolates points between two references for hinted coordinates.

methods.name: af_glyph_hints_align_weak_points
methods.description: Aligns weak points based on edge positions, similar to TrueType IUP.

methods.name: af_glyph_hints_scale_dim
methods.description: Applies warp scale and delta to points in a given dimension.
